abstract: The present study was undertaken to investigate whether human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) beta-core fragment (hCG beta cf) was directly produced by gestational trophoblastic tumors. Immunoreactivity of hCG beta cf was demonstrated in the extracts as well as in the culture media of hydatidiform mole tissues. It was also present in the extracts of choriocarcinoma tissues, and its molar concentration exceeded that of intact hCG. The presence of hCG beta cf was then confirmed by gel chromatography and Western blot analysis. Immunohistochemistry showed localization of hCG beta cf immunoreactivity to the syncytiotrophoblasts and scattered cells in the stroma of mole tissue, and to syncytiotrophoblastic cells in choriocarcinoma. Immunoreactivity of hCG beta cf was also detected in the sera of the patients with gestational trophoblastic disease, although the hCG beta cf/hCG ratio was less than one hundredth of that in the tissue extracts. Serial measurement of serum hCG beta cf levels after mole evacuation showed that they declined much more rapidly than those of hCG and became undetectable in the patients with subsequent spontaneous resolution, while hCG beta cf remained or became detectable before the rise of hCG was observed in the patients with subsequent persistent trophoblastic disease. Taken together, these results suggest that hCG beta cf is directly produced by gestational trophoblastic tumors, and monitoring of hCG beta cf in the serum after mole evacuation may be useful for early prediction of subsequent development of postmolar persistent trophoblastic disease.
abstract_ja: 本研究は、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)のβコア断片(hCGβcf)が妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍によって直接産生されるかどうかを検討した。胞状奇胎組織の抽出液および培養上清にhCGβcfの免疫反応性が認められ、絨毛癌組織の抽出液にも存在し、そのモル濃度は無傷のhCGを上回った。hCGβcfの存在はゲル濾過およびウェスタンブロット解析により確認された。免疫組織化学では、胞状奇胎組織の合胞体栄養膜細胞および間質内の散在性細胞、ならびに絨毛癌の合胞体栄養膜細胞にhCGβcf免疫反応性の局在が認められた。妊娠性絨毛性疾患の患者血清においてもhCGβcfの免疫反応性が検出されたが、そのhCGβcf/hCG比は組織抽出液の100分の1未満であった。胞状奇胎排出後の血清hCGβcfの連続測定では、hCGよりもはるかに速やかに低下し、自然寛解した患者では検出されなくなった。一方、続発性の胞状奇胎後持続性絨毛性疾患の患者では、hCGの上昇に先立ってhCGβcfが残存あるいは出現した。以上より、hCGβcfは妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍によって直接産生されており、胞状奇胎排出後の血清中hCGβcfのモニタリングは、続発性持続性絨毛性疾患の早期予測に有用である可能性が示唆された。
